How to play

  1. The clock is your health. It starts at 30 seconds and ticks down.
  2. Move to dodge. You shoot by yourself at the closest enemy.
  3. A hit costs 3 seconds. A kill wins back 1 second.
  4. Every 20 seconds a new wave comes: more enemies, and faster.
  5. Rings show where enemies will appear. Yellow dashers aim a line before they charge.
